data_use_quote: There are no restrictions on this site
data_use_scope: Provider statement about distribution of global bathymetry and gravity grids; the MB-System GPL in the preceding paragraph concerns software, not these numerical data. No claim of a Creative Commons license is made.
grid_version: V33.1 as identified by the extractor page on acquisition date
version_note: The public directory also has V34 files; the extractor explicitly identifies its gravity grid as V33.1. Native grid sampling is 1 minute; the documented marine low-pass filter has half gain at 16 km. Grid sampling is not effective spatial resolution.
